## 0.0 Introduction and Set-up

In this script I will perform an EWAS on the X and Y chromosome probes for eoPRED score and placental pathology in the SPAH cohort.

### 0.1 Packages

```{r packages, warning=F, message=F}

library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(limma)
library(biobroom)
library(lumi)
library(cowplot)
library(ggrepel)
library(UMtools)
library(ggpubr)

#load the EPIC probe information
probeInfo <- readRDS("//fs/teams/RobinsonLab/Hannah/05_Projects/SPAH/E. Sex and Environment Project [abandon]/02_Outputs/02_Variability/hg38_b5_EPIC_probeinfo.rds")
probeInfo <- probeInfo %>% mutate(Start_hg38 = as.numeric(Start_hg38))

chrXprobes_EPIC <- probeInfo %>% filter(chr == "chrX")
chrYprobes_EPIC <- probeInfo %>% filter(chr == "chrY")
remove(probeInfo)

set.seed(4815)
theme_set(theme_minimal())
theme_update(
  panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
  axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
  axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
  axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
  legend.position="none"
  )

```

### 0.3 Linear Modelling Function

```{r lm-functions}

linear_modelling <- function(betas,mvals,model){
#run model on m values & calculate empirical Bayesian statistics
  fit<- lmFit(mvals, model) %>% eBayes()
  td <- biobroom::tidy.MArrayLM(fit)
  
  #calculate delta beta
  fit_B <- lmFit(betas, model) %>% eBayes()
  td <- td %>% mutate(delB =
                        (biobroom::tidy.MArrayLM(fit_B))$estimate)
  
  #calculate SE of regression coefficients
  se_coef <- sqrt(fit_B$s2.post) * fit_B$stdev.unscaled
  se_coef <- se_coef %>% as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column(var="probeID") %>%
    pivot_longer(-"probeID", names_to= "term", values_to="se")
  
  #multiple test correct
  td <- td %>% 
    dplyr::rename(probeID = gene) %>% #biobroom assumes tested genes, not CpGs, rename
    group_by(term) %>%
    mutate(fdr = p.adjust(p.value, method="fdr")) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    as.data.frame()
  
  td <- td %>%
    left_join(se_coef, by=c("probeID" = "probeID", "term"="term")) %>%
    mutate(ConfInt_95 = delB + 1.96*se,
           ConfInt_5 = delB - 1.96*se)
  return(td)
}

lm_significant_hits <- function(td){
#significant hits 
sig_hits <- matrix(c(
  nrow(td %>% filter(fdr<0.05)),
  nrow(td %>% filter(fdr<0.05 & abs(delB) > 0.05)),
  nrow(td %>% filter(fdr<0.05 & abs(delB) > 0.1)),
  nrow(td %>% filter(fdr<0.05 & abs(delB) > 0.25)),
  nrow(td %>% filter(fdr<0.05 & abs(delB) > 0.5)),
  nrow(td %>% filter(fdr<0.01)),
  nrow(td %>% filter(fdr<0.01 & abs(delB) > 0.05)),
  nrow(td %>% filter(fdr<0.01 & abs(delB) > 0.1)),
  nrow(td %>% filter(fdr<0.01 & abs(delB) > 0.25)),
  nrow(td %>% filter(fdr<0.01 & abs(delB) > 0.5))
  ),ncol=2)

colnames(sig_hits) <- c("FDR < 0.05", "FDR < 0.01")
rownames(sig_hits) <- c("delB >0", "delB >0.05", "delB >0.1", "delB >0.25", "delB >0.5")
sig_hits <-as.table(sig_hits)

return(sig_hits)
}

```

## 1.0 Linear Models

In my linear models when I correct for cell-composition I will include Syncytiotrophoblasts, Stromal, Endothelial, and nRBC. I excluded Trophoblasts/Cytotrophoblast because it was highly correlated (R2 >= 0.80, cut-off based on PMID: 31304696) with the proportion of Syncytiotrophoblasts (made up the larger proportion of samples). Syncytiotrophoblasts were correlated with Stromal and Endothelial cell-proportions but not with a R^2 >= 0.80. I excluded Hofbauer because it made up less than 1% of most samples. I knew this from my previous work with this cohort in my Pathology project.


Models:

i) DNAme ~ eoPRED score 
ii) DNAme ~ eoPRED score + GA + ancestry
iii) DNAme ~ eoPRED score + GA + ancestry + cell composition

```{r eopred-fx}

mod_eopred1_fx <- model.matrix(~ EOPE, val_pDat_f,row.names=T)
mod_eopred2_fx <- model.matrix(~ EOPE+Prob_European+Prob_African+ga_continuous, val_pDat_f,row.names=T)
mod_eopred3_fx <- model.matrix(~ EOPE+Prob_European+Prob_African+ga_continuous+
                                 Syncytiotrophoblast+Stromal+Endothelial+nRBC, val_pDat_f,row.names=T)

head(mod_eopred3_fx) #check

lm_eopred1_fx <-linear_modelling (betas_fx,mvals_fx,mod_eopred1_fx) %>% filter (term == "EOPE")
lm_eopred2_fx <-linear_modelling (betas_fx,mvals_fx,mod_eopred2_fx) %>% filter (term == "EOPE")
lm_eopred3_fx <-linear_modelling (betas_fx,mvals_fx,mod_eopred3_fx) %>% filter (term == "EOPE")

head(lm_eopred2_fx) #check

#hits?
lm_significant_hits(lm_eopred1_fx)
lm_significant_hits(lm_eopred2_fx)
lm_significant_hits(lm_eopred3_fx)

```

## 3.0 Hits


```{r eopred-hits}

eopred_hits_fx <- lm_eopred2_fx %>% filter(fdr<0.05 & abs(delB)>0.25)
dim(eopred_hits_fx) #4
eopred_hits_fx$probeID

eopred_hits_mx <- lm_eopred2_mx %>% filter(fdr<0.05 & abs(delB)>0.25)
dim(eopred_hits_mx) #44

table(eopred_hits_fx$probeID %in% eopred_hits_mx$probeID) #1 overlap between groups

#combine XX and XY information
colnames(lm_eopred2_fx) <- paste0(colnames(lm_eopred2_fx),"_f")
colnames(lm_eopred2_fx)
lm_eopred2_x <- lm_eopred2_mx %>% left_join(lm_eopred2_fx, by=c("probeID"="probeID_f"))
dim(lm_eopred2_x) #16070 x 21

#How do the XX hits look in XY?
lm_eopred2_x %>% filter(probeID %in% eopred_hits_fx$probeID)

#identify which probes do not have overlapping delta-beta 95% CI between XX/XY
lm_eopred2_x <- lm_eopred2_x %>%
  mutate(Overlap_CI = case_when(
    ConfInt_95_f < ConfInt_5 ~ F,
    ConfInt_5_f > ConfInt_95 ~ F,
    .default = T),
    Same_Direction_CI = sign(delB) == sign(delB_f))

table(lm_eopred2_x$Overlap_CI) #442

#classify the hits using the criteria
eopred_hits_x <- lm_eopred2_x %>%
  filter(probeID %in% eopred_hits_mx$probeID |
           probeID %in% eopred_hits_fx$probeID) %>%
  mutate(Sex_specific_call = 
           ifelse(probeID %in% eopred_hits_mx$probeID,
             case_when(
               Overlap_CI==F & p.value_f>=0.05 ~ "Sex Specific",
               Overlap_CI==F & p.value_f<0.05 & Same_Direction_CI==T ~ "Sex Differential",
               Overlap_CI==F & p.value_f<0.05 & Same_Direction_CI==F ~ "Sex Opposite",
               Overlap_CI==T & p.value_f<0.05 ~ "Association in both sexes",
               Overlap_CI==T & p.value_f>=0.05 ~ "Association in one sex"),
             case_when(
               Overlap_CI==F & p.value>=0.05 ~ "Sex Specific",
               Overlap_CI==F & p.value<0.05 & Same_Direction_CI==T ~ "Sex Differential",
               Overlap_CI==F & p.value<0.05 & Same_Direction_CI==F ~ "Sex Opposite",
               Overlap_CI==T & p.value<0.05 ~ "Association in both sexes",
               Overlap_CI==T & p.value>=0.05 ~ "Association in one sex")))
table(eopred_hits_x$Sex_specific_call)


```

```{r eopred-hits-save}

lm_eopred2_x_save <- eopred_hits_x %>%
  dplyr::select(probeID, p.value, fdr, delB, ConfInt_5, ConfInt_95,
                p.value_f, fdr_f, delB_f, ConfInt_5_f, ConfInt_95_f,
                Overlap_CI, Same_Direction_CI, Sex_specific_call) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    XY_pval = p.value,
    XY_fdr = fdr,
    XY_delB = delB,
    XY_lowCI = ConfInt_5,
    XY_highCI = ConfInt_95,
    XX_pval = p.value_f,
    XX_fdr = fdr_f,
    XX_delB = delB_f,
    XX_lowCI = ConfInt_5_f,
    XX_highCI = ConfInt_95_f
  ) %>%
  left_join((chrXprobes_EPIC %>% dplyr::select(probeID, chr,pos, UCSC_RefGene_Name,
                                               GencodeBasicV12_NAME, Regulatory_Region)))

```

### 3.1 Sex specific interaction test

Run the linear model for eoPRED score on the X chromosome hits in all samples and test to see if the interaction term is significant for the hits (testing for sex-specific and sex-differential effects).

```{r sex-specific-test}

val_pDat_x <- val_pDat %>% filter(!is.na(ga_continuous))
betas_x_hits <- val_betas[lm_eopred2_x_save$probeID,val_pDat_x$rgset_colnames]
dim(betas_x_hits) #47 x 492
mvals_x_hits <- lumi::beta2m(betas_x_hits)

mod_x_hits <- model.matrix(~ EOPE*Sex_Predic+Prob_European+Prob_African+ga_continuous, val_pDat_x,row.names=T)

head(mod_x_hits)

lm_x_hits <-linear_modelling (betas_x_hits,mvals_x_hits,mod_x_hits) %>% filter (term == "EOPE:Sex_PredicXY")

table((lm_x_hits %>% 
  left_join(lm_eopred2_x_save))$Sex_specific_call, (lm_x_hits %>% 
  left_join(lm_eopred2_x_save))$fdr<0.05)

lm_eopred2_x_save <- lm_eopred2_x_save %>%
  left_join((lm_x_hits %>%
               dplyr::select(probeID, delB, fdr) %>%
               dplyr::rename(Int_delB = delB,
                             Int_fdr = fdr)), by="probeID")

```


### 3.2 Figure 3

```{r fig-3}

labs <- c("cg24865241\nAssociation in both sexes",
          "cg07924363\nSex Differential",
          "cg16667333\nXY Specific")
names(labs) <- c("cg24865241", "cg07924363","cg16667333")

eopred_hits_sp <- betas_x_hits[c("cg24865241","cg07924363","cg16667333"),] %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column(var="rgset_colnames")%>%
  pivot_longer(-c(rgset_colnames),names_to="probeID", values_to = "Beta")%>%
  left_join(val_pDat_x, by="rgset_colnames") %>%
  mutate(probeID = factor(probeID, levels = c("cg24865241","cg07924363","cg16667333"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=EOPE, y=Beta, color=Sex_Predic))+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("#bf4e52","#407799"))+
  labs(x="eoPRED score", y=expression(paste("DNAme (",beta,")")), color="Sex")+
  theme(legend.position="bottom",
```
